rows.title: Waiting on design: commodity search lists results as the trader types, in both animals sets, once commodities come from MDM
rows.detail: The commodity search lists results as the trader types, behind an icon search button, announces results and selections in a polite live region, and keeps the typed text open for more ticks, with Escape closing the results. The 9 October afternoon ruling keeps today's server-side search, which already works without JavaScript, and holds this behaviour until design answers its question about search as you type; it is also held until commodities come from MDM. When both have happened it is built as design says with an accepted component, or dropped if design drops it. This is the live-animals half of the row; the germinal set's copy of the same behaviour is the germinal-products area's draft for it.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript, typing in the commodity search lists matching results as the trader types, with no Search press. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-078, prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-081; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-008, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-023; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-053, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-008)
The page does not carry the whole commodity list: results come from the service's MDM commodity search through reference-data as the trader types. (c-012)

A visually hidden polite live region announces the number of results, such as '11 results available', and the number of species chosen, such as '1 option selected' and '2 options selected', and is left empty after Clear all; the results list is labelled 'Commodity search results'. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-029, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-030, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-032, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-038, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-042, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-046; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-054)

With JavaScript, ticking a species keeps the typed search text, leaves the results open for more ticks and adds the species to the selected panel. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-039, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-039-m1; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-057)

With JavaScript, pressing Escape closes the results and empties the search field, and the selection stays in the panel. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-044; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-057)
A species chosen as you type is saved by Save and continue like one chosen without JavaScript. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-039)
With and without JavaScript, the commodity page has no serious or critical axe violations under the wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and wcag22aa tags. (trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p8-057)
Every new English string, such as the live region's announcements and the results label, has its Welsh counterpart, marked as a machine draft. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-044)

The commodity search is a full-width box with a square GOV.UK blue icon button joined to its right, whose accessible name is 'Search' (Welsh as today), and no separate 'Search' text button; with JavaScript off, pressing the button or Enter still searches on the server. (review:designers-2026-10-19 S08; prototype:dr2-1-source what-are-you-importing.html:87 at 56371e2; moved from design-snagging inc-210 on 20 Oct)
rows.gate: Look at the as-you-type search with and without JavaScript, with a screen reader's announcements, before any other client-side component copies its pattern; check its script is in the built bundle on a fresh stack.
openQuestions: Design must answer its question about commodity search as you type: build it as design says with an accepted component and no custom JavaScript copied from the prototype, or drop it if design drops it (ruling 2026-10-09 afternoon, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-059, -p2-008; c-012).

Blocked also until commodities come from MDM: whoever owns the MDM integration must make the MDM commodity list reach the animals frontend through trade-imports-reference-data, after which the area is re-distilled (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-060, -p2-008; c-278).

Blocked 20 Oct (Sam): waits for the MDM commodity API and the commodity type-ahead component: EUDPA-617 'Integrate early-access MDM commodity API into live animals frontend' (frontend to reference-data to MDM) and EUDPA-616 'Add a search type-ahead for choosing commodities, reusable across the journey' (the JavaScript type-ahead over the no-JavaScript search-then-tick fallback).
rows.notes: Combines the live-typing slice (req-072), the live-region slice (req-073) and the tick-and-Escape slice (req-074): one client-side behaviour on one page, none observable apart from the others. Kept apart from the MDM catalogue row because it carries a second blocker, design's unanswered question, that the catalogue does not. The existing row inc-014 also holds the germinal set's copy of this behaviour (req-1782, the germinal-products area's), so the combiner should keep inc-014's id, theme (waiting-on-design), gate, dependencies and its germinal criterion, and merge the germinal-products area's draft into it, as the 9 October afternoon ruling makes design's question one increment. Its external dependency on the commodities-and-reason search-results row (inc-013) stays. The prototype's whole list shipped with the page is not copied (c-012 outcome; its overruled claims are not named). A new client-side entry must be wired into the frontend's build, or it fails silently. Design snagging merged to main 23 Oct: the joined blue icon search button is now one shared macro, appSubmittedSearch, built from MoJ Search classes; build the last criterion by switching the commodity search page to it rather than with new markup, and reuse the bold-match helper for as-you-type results. Re-analysis 27 Oct (main checked at animals-frontend ba85c222 after EUDPA-617 c3183a8e): the block still applies in part. Design's question is unanswered. The live-animals half of the MDM block has gone, because the search now calls reference-data; the germinal half still waits. The EUDPA-616 branch predates EUDPA-617 and edits a file it deleted, so it needs rebasing; it carries no Escape handling, no results label and no 'options selected' announcement, and its own icon button duplicates main's shared macro.

rows.title: The germinal commodity page searches MDM's germinal commodities, and the live animals search still offers none
rows.detail: Each set's commodity catalogue holds only its own commodities (ruling 2026-10-09), so the live-animals commodity search gives up the germinal product lines it carries today: a live-animals trader is never offered semen, embryos or ova, while every live-animal commodity can still be found, chosen and saved. This is the live-animals half of the row; the germinal set's own catalogue and its copy of the page are the germinal-products area's draft for it.
acceptanceCriteria: On a live animals notification, searching the commodity page for 'semen' or 05119985 lists no results. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-025, -p1-026; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-018; c-222)

Live commodities found through the live search, such as cattle 0102, horses 0101 and cats under 01061900, can still be chosen and saved. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-019, -p2-025; repo:tests repo-tests-p1-042)

rows.notes: req-1754 already sits in inc-016, beside the germinal-products area's req-092, which states the same removal from the germinal side (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-018 places it there). The combiner should fold this draft into inc-016 with the germinal-products area's draft for that row, keeping inc-016's id, theme (germinal-products) and dependency on inc-176, rather than keep a row of its own. c-222 (ruled): each set's catalogue holds only its own commodities. The code the live-animals half changes is the live-animals commodity service and the browser test that lists today's catalogue, both of which the split-off commodities-and-reason theme owns, so they are listed as shared and not as this row's own code: the germinal-products theme must keep depending on commodities-and-reason, as it does today, so the two branches never build that service at the same time. Re-analysis 27 Oct (main checked at animals-frontend ba85c222 after EUDPA-617 c3183a8e): the live-animals half is already met on main, because the live search goes to reference-data and reference-data drops MDM's germinal codes, and the stub fixture holds only chapter 01 codes; so both criteria here are regression checks on that behaviour rather than new code.

rows.title: Germinal Commodity details checks weight and packages, listing errors by question
rows.detail: The germinal set's Commodity details page lists its errors by question, all species for one question before the next, so a trader fixing several species reads one question at a time. The 9 October ruling splits that ordering rule per set, and the germinal data fields make total gross weight and temperature optional, so temperature raises no error and never appears in the summary while a blank weight saves. This is the error-ordering half of the row; the germinal weight and packages validation rules are the germinal-products area's draft for it.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal-products notification, pressing Save and continue on Commodity details with errors on several species lists every Total gross weight error, species by species, before every Number of packages error, each linking to its own field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-042; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-051)

On a germinal-products notification, Temperature never appears in the Commodity details error summary, and Commodity details with no temperature chosen, a blank total gross weight and a valid number of packages for every species shows no error and saves. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023; c-232)
rows.notes: req-1762 already sits in inc-177, with the germinal-products area's weight and packages validation requirements, so the combiner should fold these two criteria into that row rather than keep a separate row, keeping inc-177's id, theme (germinal-products), its dependency on inc-017 and its external dependency on the commodities-and-reason row inc-018. It is the germinal half of the error-ordering rule whose live-animals half the commodities-and-reason theme builds. c-232 (ruled): the germinal total gross weight and temperature are optional, so the prototype's blank-weight and blank-temperature errors are not built and its overruled claims are not named. The page it changes is the germinal set's own copy of Commodity details, which does not exist until the germinal Commodity details questions row (inc-017) puts the fields on the page.

rows.title: The Overview for a germinal products notification, with Commodity details Complete on valid packages
rows.detail: The overview's task status tells a germinal trader what is left to do. The 9 October ruling splits the Commodity details completeness rule per set: on the germinal products set the task is Complete once every chosen species has a valid number of packages and any total gross weight entered is valid. The germinal data fields make total gross weight and temperature optional, so neither holds the task back. This is the Commodity details completeness half of the row; the germinal overview's own cards and regions are the notification-hub area's draft for it.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal-products notification, the overview's Commodity details task shows Complete when every chosen species has a whole number of packages from 1 to 1,000, with total gross weight and temperature left blank. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-024, prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-054; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023; c-232; c-234)

On a germinal-products notification, the overview's Commodity details task does not show Complete while any chosen species has no number of packages, or has a total gross weight entered that is not valid, such as 0. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-054; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-053)
On a germinal-products notification with no species chosen, the overview's Commodity details task does not show Complete. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-054)
rows.notes: req-1763 already sits in inc-099, the germinal products Overview, because only that overview shows the task status; the combiner should keep it there with these three criteria as that row's Commodity details Complete criteria, merged with the notification-hub area's draft for the row, keeping inc-099's id, theme (germinal-products) and its dependencies on inc-017 and inc-177. It is the germinal half of the completeness rule whose live-animals half is already met. c-232 (ruled): the germinal total gross weight and temperature are optional and do not hold the task back, so Design Release 2.1's bar of a weight above 0 and a temperature is not built. c-234 (ruled): a germinal line's quantity is its number of packages, a whole number from 1 and at most 1,000, the limit the germinal-products area's packages requirement sets in inc-177.

splitOff.why: It changes the live-animals Commodity details page, so that pressing Remove keeps the numbers a trader has typed but not yet saved. That page is frontend:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/consignment-details, with its browser test tests:tests/animals/e2e/pages/consignment-details.spec.ts and page object tests:page-objects/animals/consignment-details-page.ts, all three in the commodities-and-reason pointer's touches. The 26 October ruling adopted it after that theme was split off on 10 October, and no row in this backlog covers it, so it is that branch's to build.
